# Dylan Grosz

> Machine Learning Scientist at Apple, building on-device AI for Siri.

## About
- Stanford University, B.S. Symbolic Systems (AI concentration), 2020
- 5+ years ML experience: speaker recognition, NLP, computer vision
- On-device ML across 6 Apple platforms, 40+ languages
- U.S. Patent Application 20220383324 (predictive autoscaling)

## Research
- [AAAI 2021] Predicting Livelihood Indicators from Community-Generated Street-Level Imagery
- [PAKDD 2020] Automatic Detection of Sexist Statements Commonly Used at the Workplace
- [Computation + Journalism 2020] Disarming Loaded Words: Addressing Gender Bias in Political Reporting
